---
title: "Analyze_LFY_Alignment"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(Biostrings)
library(pwalign)
```

```{r}
lfys <- readDNAMultipleAlignment("../input/CrLFY_CDS_Aligned.fa")
```

```{r}
lfys
```

```{r}
cmat <- as.matrix(lfys)              # characters, 2 rows × N columns
matches <- cmat[1, ] == cmat[2, ]   # TRUE/FALSE per column
nongap <- cmat[1, ] != "-" | cmat[2, ] != "-"
100 * sum(matches & nongap) / sum(nongap)

```


Or

```{r}
dna <- DNAStringSet(unmasked(lfys))  
s1 <- dna[[1]]
s2 <- dna[[2]]

pal <- pairwiseAlignment(pattern = s1, subject = s2,
                         type = "global", scoreOnly = FALSE)

pid(pal, type = "PID2")
```
